description:
Extend the simulation channel layer beyond AWGN and frequency-flat fading so coded-modulation chains can be evaluated over the channels that real broadcast and cellular links experience.

## Background

`gf2-coding` exposes channels through the `ChannelModel` trait (bits to LLRs), and `gf2-sim` exposes them as `Stage<SymbolBatch, SymbolBatch>` impls with a deterministic per-frame ChaCha20 seek contract. The current set is AWGN, flat Rayleigh and flat Rician, CPU-only for fading. The `gf2-sim` fading stages do not pass channel gains to the soft demapper, so fading LLRs use an AWGN metric. Fixing that is the foundation for every further fading model.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `gf2-sim` fading chains produce LLRs under the coherent fading metric, using the per-symbol channel gain.
- [hard] REQ-02: At least one standard frequency-selective multipath profile is available and usable in a coded BER/FER sweep.
- [hard] REQ-03: Phase-noise and carrier-frequency-offset impairments are available as deterministic channel stages.
- [hard] REQ-04: Rayleigh and Rician fading stages run on the GPU path with CPU fallback.
- [hard] REQ-05: Every channel stage keeps byte-identical frame output across worker counts at a fixed seed.

## Notes

Channel models outside this list are added as further children rather than excluded in module documentation.
title: Channel models for link simulation
